name: @chey.dev/filemcp
description: Local MCP filesystem server for reading, writing, and listing files and creating directories within an AgentFiles sandbox.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check client.js && node --check tools.js && node --check toolSchemas.js
scripts.patch: npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
scripts.minor: npm version minor && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
scripts.major: npm version major && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public

author: cheyanna graham
